body:
Thanks everyone for attending! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8162):

### Agenda

1. Review past action items
    1. Eric to reply to every unresolved comment on the [PR for directionality in the shadow DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7424).
        1. Eric replied to all and resolved nearly all comments. Eric will check with Elika about the tests.
    1. Emilio will work on a concrete proposal for [Define OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D.font setter in detail](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7847).
        1. No progress.
    1. Mason will comment on the [Scoped Custom Element Registries](https://github.com/WICG/webcomponents/issues/716) issue.
        1. Justin commented, Ryosuke's concerns were addressed. Mason will draft a PR.
    1. Domenic will comment on the dialog element [individual blockers](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4184#issuecomment-1072536425) with his opinion on how blocking/non-blocking they are toward further progress.
        1. Will wait for Domenic to comment on the remaining issues.
    1. Emilio will work on a PR and tests for [Proposal: extend FocusOptions to allow specifying :focus-visible behavior](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7830).
        1. Done.
    1. Joey will add use counters to see potential breakage with adopting Chromium's behavior for [Event bubbling on disabled form elements](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5886) and decide which compat breakage is more tenable. Kagami will test more scenarios for event target.
        1. Use Counters were [added](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5886#issuecomment-1189861050), breakage seems high in prerelease channels, a quick fix is not an option. Plausible plans will be discussed in the GitHub issue.
    1. Mason will ensure the updated proposal is posted in the [autocomplete attribute for street-address details](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4986) issue.
        1. The new proposal is measurably better for the Brazil test case (4% -> 100%), positive feedback on the issue. Mason will update the group next time with even more test data. Looking almost ready for a spec PR, no objections raised.
    1. Domenic will open a new issue about alternative times for this meeting with several proposals to consider.
        1. [Done](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8106).
1. Carryovers from last time
1. New topics
    1. [Emilio] [focus delegate code seems wrongly only looking at children](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8157)
        1. Will discuss next time with Emilio present.
    1. [Emilio] [autofocus + delegateFocus handling doesn't make much sense to me](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8156)
        1. Will discuss next time with Emilio present.
    1. [Tim] [Which input types should readonly affect constraint validation for?](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8133)
        1. The group agreed with Domenic's proposal in the issue.
    1. [Domenic] [HTML Standard triage meeting times](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8106)
        1. Agreement to try out the proposed changes, a question was raised about limiting the meeting to 30 minutes since it will be more frequent.

### Action Items

1. @meyerweb will check with Elika about the tests for the [PR for directionality in the shadow DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7424).
1. @emilio will work on a concrete proposal for [Define OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D.font setter in detail](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7847).
1. @mfreed7 will draft a PR for [Scoped Custom Element Registries](https://github.com/WICG/webcomponents/issues/716).
1. @domenic will comment on the dialog element [individual blockers](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4184#issuecomment-1072536425) with his opinion on how blocking/non-blocking they are toward further progress.
1. @mfreed7 will update the group next time with even more test data from the [autocomplete attribute for street-address details](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4986) issue.
1. @past will update the calendar invite with the [new agreed upon times](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8106).
